description: Side-by-side gene maps of the three independent AcrVA1 loci in M. bovoculi
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def cds_window(acc,s,e):
    ft=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi",params={"db":"nuccore","id":acc,"rettype":"ft","retmode":"text",
        "seq_start":s,"seq_stop":e},timeout=150).text
    recs=[];cur=None
    for ln in ft.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith(">Feature") or not ln.strip(): continue
        p=ln.split("\t")
        if p[0] and re.match(r'^[<>]?\d+$',p[0]):
            a=int(p[0].lstrip("<>")); b=int(p[1].lstrip("<>")) if len(p)>1 and p[1] else a
            t=p[2] if len(p)>2 else ""
            if t: cur={"s":min(a,b)+s-1,"e":max(a,b)+s-1,"str":"+" if a<=b else "-","type":t}; recs.append(cur)
        elif len(p)>=5 and p[3] and cur is not None: cur.setdefault(p[3],p[4])
    d=pd.DataFrame(recs)
    return d[d.type=="CDS"]
loci=[("M. bovoculi 58069\nNZ_CP011374.1","CP011374.1",1616725,1660000,1623942),
      ("M. bovoculi SL1\nNZ_JBXGIU010000001.1","NZ_JBXGIU010000001.1",543000,570000,547433),
      ("M. bovoculi GCF_056854595.1\nNZ_JBXGGA010000048.1","NZ_JBXGGA010000048.1",1,10813,10014)]
def cat(p):
    p=str(p).lower()
    if "acrva1" in p: return ("AcrVA1","#E03131")
    if "acrva2" in p: return ("AcrVA2","#F08C00")
    if "recombinase" in p or "integrase" in p: return ("integrase/recombinase","#5F3DC4")
    if any(k in p for k in ["phage","tail","terminase","tape measure","capsid","portal"]): return ("phage structural","#1971C2")
    return ("other / hypothetical","#CED4DA")
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,7.5))
for ax,(lab,acc,s,e,acr) in zip(axes,loci):
    d=cds_window(acc,s,e)
    for _,r in d.iterrows():
        nm,c=cat(r.get("product",""))
        y=0.2 if r["str"]=="+" else -0.2
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle(((r.s-s)/1000,y-0.12),(r.e-r.s)/1000,0.24,color=c,ec="none"))
    ax.axvline((acr-s)/1000,color="black",lw=0.8,ls=":")
    ax.set_xlim(-0.5,(e-s)/1000+0.5); ax.set_ylim(-0.6,0.6); ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.set_ylabel(lab,fontsize=7.5,rotation=0,ha="right",va="center")
    ax.set_xlabel("kb from window start",fontsize=8)
import matplotlib.patches as mp
handles=[mp.Patch(color=c,label=n) for n,c in [("AcrVA1","#E03131"),("AcrVA2","#F08C00"),
         ("integrase/recombinase","#5F3DC4"),("phage structural","#1971C2"),("other / hypothetical","#CED4DA")]]
axes[0].legend(handles=handles,fontsize=8,ncol=5,loc="upper center",bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,1.55))
axes[0].set_title("acrVA1-acrVA2 cassettes sit in phage gene neighbourhoods in three independent Moraxella bovoculi assemblies",
                  fontsize=10,pad=28)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
